关键词: J.D. Power Best Brand Loyalty Award
主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. has been awarded the J.D. Power 2021 Best Brand Loyalty Award for the third consecutive year, achieving a loyalty rate of 61.8%, the highest overall score across both the mass market (non-luxury) and luxury automakers. The award recognizes brands for longevity, value, trust, and performance, based on customer behavior when trading in an existing vehicle for a new one. The study used transaction data from June 2020 through May 2021, highlighting Subaru's reputation for safety, trust, and value. The award underscores the importance of brand loyalty in driving customer repurchase and referrals, reinforcing Subaru's position as a leader in customer retention within the automotive industry.
